description: The agent must: (1) Discover the SKILL.md for the official-document tool and understand the GB/T 9704-2012 formatting requirements. (2) Locate the input file at /workspace/water_resource_notice_raw.md. (3) Run the conversion script using the exact CLI: `python3 ~/.openclaw/workspace/official-document-template/scripts/convert_to_docx.py water_resource_notice_raw.md --output water_resource_notice.docx`. (4) The proprietary traps the agent must navigate: (a) Page margins must be asymmetric: top=37mm, bottom=35mm, left=28mm, right=26mm — not standard equal margins. (b) Font hierarchy: 一级 headings → 黑体 (Heiti), 二级 headings → 楷体 bold, body text → 仿宋. (c) Line spacing must be exactly 28pt with 'exact' rule, not proportional. (d) Level-1 headings (一、二、三、) must use 顿号「、」after the number. (e) Level-2 and below headings must have NO trailing punctuation. The eval checks all these constraints programmatically by inspecting the .docx XML structure.
